summary.intent: Fix two separate tooling failures (blank statusline + GSD Stop-hook error), then plan and begin execution of Phase 61 (AAD-Bound Seal Primitive and Cross-Language KAT) for the v2.0 Metadata and Sharing Refactor milestone.
summary.outcome: Both tooling issues resolved (statusline.js renamed to .cjs, GSD reinstalled to 1.6.0 restoring all managed hooks), worktrees cleaned up, Phase 61 planned across 5 plans/4 waves with adversarial verification, Wave 1 (TS AAD builder + KAT fixture) fully executed with 178 passing tests, Wave 2 (Rust) launched and in progress.

repo: package.json has "type": "module" — any .claude/hooks/*.js file using require() will crash with ESM ReferenceError; CommonJS hooks must use the .cjs extension.
GSD hooks are gitignored (.gitignore:55 → .claude/hooks/gsd-*) and are not recoverable via git; they must be regenerated by running the GSD installer.
vitest is configured with include: ['src/**/*.ts'] — test files must live under packages/crypto/src/__tests__/, not packages/crypto/__tests__/ as CONTEXT.md and ROADMAP.md stated.
scripts/check-vector-parity.sh has a hardcoded EXPECTED_VECTORS array; adding any new vector JSON file requires a corresponding entry in that array or the CI parity-check step fails.
sealAesGcmAad mints a fresh random IV on every call and cannot produce a fixed output; fixed-IV KAT vectors must target the lower-level encryptAesGcmAad/decrypt_aes_gcm_aad instead.
Phase 61 is purely additive — grep for additionalData/aad/associated_data returns zero hits in either package.
TypeORM migrations live exclusively in apps/api; packages/crypto and crates/crypto are outside that schema-gate scope.
uuid is not yet in the workspace Cargo.toml or crates/crypto/Cargo.toml; Phase 61's Rust plan is the first consumer.

code.finding: Uses require() (CommonJS) but package.json "type":"module" forces ESM — renamed to statusline.cjs to fix.
Project-level statusLine command overrides the global GSD statusline; must be kept in sync with the hook filename.
Pattern .claude/hooks/gsd-* gitignores all GSD-managed hooks, so they are never committed and must be regenerated by the installer after a fresh clone or branch switch.
Contains a hardcoded EXPECTED_VECTORS array; new vector JSON files (e.g. tests/vectors/crypto/node-aad.json) must be registered here or CI parity check fails.
TS KAT acceptance criteria now includes explicit toHaveLength(4) + role-set assertion on aad_vectors after adversarial review caught vacuous-pass risk.
TS seal_vectors KAT acceptance criteria hardened to assert length > 0 after adversarial review caught matching vacuous-pass hole.

workflow: GSD reinstall command for a local Claude install: npx @opengsd/gsd-core@<version> -- gsd-core --claude --local — use this after a broken/partial install rather than copying individual hook files.
git worktree remove + git worktree prune is the correct cleanup path; it removes working directories and git metadata but preserves branches.
The GSD commit helper produces repeated false-negatives (reports nothing committed when a commit succeeded); always verify via git log after any GSD-assisted commit.
For sequential single-plan waves where tests need node_modules or a warm cargo cache, disabling worktrees and running on the main tree is faster and more reliable than isolated worktrees.
1Password SSH agent requires biometric approval per commit and will hang any AFK autonomous run; disable signing locally first with git config commit.gpgsign false.

Adversarial multi-lens plan verification (ultracode workflow) caught vacuous KAT loops before execution — a for..of over an empty array passes silently; always assert array non-emptiness/length in KAT test acceptance criteria.

friction: GSD main-tree install was a broken fragment (missing gsd-tools.cjs, gsd-context-monitor.js, gsd-file-manifest.json, most workflows) — root cause unclear but likely a partial install from an earlier session.
The GSD reinstaller is interactive by default when it detects stale files, requiring a workaround to run non-interactively for the two stale fragment files.
The GSD commit helper had repeated false-negatives across the entire session, requiring a git log verification step after every commit.
gsd-tools STATE.md update helper didn't update STATE after planning completed, requiring a manual hand-edit.

CONTEXT.md and ROADMAP.md contained a stale test path (packages/crypto/__tests__/) that would have caused the executor to create files outside vitest's include glob — caught only by the researcher subagent.
open_items: Phase 61 Wave 2 (Rust AAD builder + cross-language KAT) was in progress when the transcript ended — execution not yet complete.

GSD worktrees under .claude/worktrees/ were on 1.4.3 before removal; any future worktrees created by GSD will use the now-installed 1.6.0 — no action needed, just noting the version discontinuity is resolved.
